title: GPU map
subtitle: What sits in video memory right now, model by model, and what else would fit. Read from Ollama every few seconds.
noVram: This machine's video memory size is not known, so the map shows what is loaded but not what is free. On NVIDIA it comes from the driver; on other cards from the system.
nothingLoaded: Nothing is loaded. The first request will pay the model's load time.

block.spilled: {bytes} did not fit and runs from system RAM, slower
block.underReported: Ollama reports {reported} in memory for this model, less than its own {file} file: that cannot be true, the weights alone are the file. This Ollama version under-reports memory on its llama.cpp runner, so the map uses the file size instead and cannot show the context's share.

fits.title: What else would fit
fits.hint: Each pulled model that is not loaded, against the free space. A model needs about 15% more than its file for a modest context.
fits.fits-now: fits now, next to what is loaded
fits.fits-alone: fits only if what is loaded unloads first
fits.too-big: larger than this card: would run partly from system RAM

foot: What this page does not know: how the daemon splits one model's footprint between weights and context. The weights are the file on disk; the rest is the context's cache and working buffers, so that split is an estimate. Free space is video memory minus what Ollama reports loaded; other programs using the GPU are not counted.
